annotations.title: Alert Rule Quality (Was It Right to Fire?)

description: How often an alert rule is right, from its labeled alerts of the last 14 days: correct (an attack, probe or scan, even failed or small), wrong (the rule mistook legitimate use of the app for an attack), unclear; precision = correct / (correct + wrong) over the alerts the rule as it is now would still raise (each alert is replayed through the current conditions and exclusions), target 95%. fixed lists wrong alerts a rule change or exclusion no longer raises; dropped lists correct ones it no longer raises (lost detections). Lists the wrong and unclear alerts with the reason and the legitimate pattern, a sample of correct ones, and what detection learning did: an exclusion it learned for legitimate traffic (with before/after precision) or a "needs a person" analysis when no safe fix passed its safety gate.
